description: This file defines the DelegatorElement class, which models the <delegator> element in an entity configuration XML file. It encapsulates various attributes of the delegator configuration, including references to child <group-map> elements and their mappings. The class provides accessor methods to retrieve configuration details and ensures proper XML parsing and validation.

classes.name: DelegatorElement
classes.description: A class that models the <delegator> element from configuration XML, encapsulating attributes and child <group-map> elements with validation and access methods.

methods.name: DelegatorElement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by parsing the XML Element and extracting attributes and child elements, throwing exceptions if required attributes are missing.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the value of the 'name' attribute.

methods.name: getEntityEcaEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether entity ECA is enabled based on the 'entity-eca-enabled' attribute.

methods.name: getEntityEcaHandlerClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name for the ECA handler.

methods.name: getDistributedCacheClearEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether distributed cache clear is enabled.

methods.name: getDistributedCacheClearClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name for cache clearing.

methods.name: getDistributedCacheClearUserLoginId
methods.description: Returns the user login ID used for cache clearing.

methods.name: getSequencedIdPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for sequenced IDs.

methods.name: getKeyEncryptingKey
methods.description: Returns the key used for encryption.

methods.name: getGroupMapList
methods.description: Returns the list of child <group-map> elements.

methods.name: getGroupDataSource
methods.description: Returns the data source name associated with a specific group name, or null if not present.
